up: Retrieve activity records for the human single-protein target CHEMBL3514 (Platelet-activating factor acetylhydrolase). Return exactly 1000 rows. Required output columns: assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Apply filters for organism 'Homo sapiens', target_type 'SINGLE PROTEIN', standard_type 'IC50', standard_relation '=', and non-null pChEMBL values. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3514' AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
